items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: And oh, Tommy Goslin and Truitte Jones and Curtis Hurt

ctx.x: Why, were you playing great music, or just having a good time, or --

Well, it was a great bunch of guys and we -- let's see, Harry James was in that band for awhile. And oh, Tommy Goslin and Truitte Jones and Curtis Hurt and, oh, the arranger -- oh, he later arranged a lot for the Bob Crosby band -- oh, a saxophone player. I can't think of his name. He's been an important arranger. I'll think of it. But he was in the band, he was writing arrangements for it, and it was quite a pleasant time. Of course that came to an end and I went to work in -- over in the east Texas oil fields,…

from drinking out of the fruit jars. And there was a continuous fight going on there all the time. A real hard, rough job, and everything was very expensive. When it would rain the streets were so bad there was guys that made a living, they'd charge you fifty bucks to carry you across the street, because the mud got so deep, that east Texas red clay.
